Author: Noranda
Name: XIV Shinies Sync
Punchline: Your collections, on xiv-shinies.com, as you earn them.
Description: Records your collection progress on XIV Shinies (https://xiv-shinies.com). New quest, achievement, mount, minion, and orchestrion unlocks appear within seconds; Triple Triad cards, tamed beasts, Occult Crescent progress, and tracked items sync in the background. Nothing uploads until you finish setup and choose what to send; Crucible run sharing is opt-in. Use /shinies to get started.
